title: Oscar and the Parish
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: August Yarrow, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
